correctness.rationale: The proof derives every stage rate from independent edge clocks and independence across petals; identifies slow stages through concavity; verifies each convolution prefactor and the exact telescoping product. Crucially, the new varying-rate limit uses the exact two-exponential survival formula with rate separation O(1/log m) and a uniform exponential-moment bound for interior phases. Then the triangular-array maximum limit follows from m times the tail. The finite-state checker independently tests exact rational CTMC moments, cut rates, finite CDFs and normalization calculations (1,733 checks). No infinite conclusion depends on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: A natural epidemiological network with an infected common source and locally dense groups has two competing transmission time bottlenecks. Matching their rates causes a divergent loglog m delay; a window of width 1/log m has a nonconstant and explicitly computable crossover function. This resolves the completion-time boundary for all fixed local clique sizes k≥2 and offers a quantitative mechanism by which small contact-rate changes affect extreme epidemic finishing times. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere renamed textbook extreme-value calculation, because the precise contact-rate resonance and triangular crossover are derived for the specified epidemic graph.
